revisions.observation: Developer review noted that validate_memory.py previously only checked 3 layout paths hardcoded in the script, while core_manifest.json declared 7 layout paths.
revisions.claim: A structural validation script must check all paths defined in the manifest rather than a hardcoded subset to support a structural completeness claim.
revisions.prediction: Refactoring validate_memory.py to iterate dynamically through manifest layout entries will verify whether all 7 declared paths exist.
revisions.test: Updated tools/validate_memory.py to iterate through all manifest layout key-value pairs and executed it via tool-run.
revisions.outcome: Execution confirmed all 7 declared layout paths (identity, memories, workspace, synthesis, persona, journal, prompts) exist under the memory root.
revisions.revision: Verification tools must dynamically evaluate target manifest data structures completely; partial hardcoded checks produce misleading completeness signals.
